svg.text: ResBack - Dashboard, Analytics and Report Features
Dashed arrows: selected dependencies. + public; ? nullable; underline: class-scoped member.
PDF reports use Dompdf; Excel exports use PhpSpreadsheet. Controllers extend Controller.
CATEGORY_LABELS is a class constant. DateRange is readonly. Parameter defaults are omitted.
rank() computes fresh results; rebuildCategory() persists rankings. Shared classes also appear in other views.
Source: app/Http/Controllers, app/Services, app/Support | inspected 24 September 2026.
